parameters.name: BuyCount
parameters.description:
The subscription duration of the renewed instance. Default value: 1.
- If **Period** is set to **Year**, the valid values are **1 to 5**.
- If **Period** is set to **Month**, the valid values are **1 to 60**.

parameters.name: ChargeType
parameters.description: The billing method. Set the value to **PREPAY**, which indicates the subscription billing method.

parameters.name: DtsJobId
parameters.description: The ID of the data synchronization or change tracking task. You can call [DescribeDtsJobs](~~209702~~) to query the task ID.

parameters.name: Period
parameters.description:
The billing method for the renewal instance. Valid values:
- **Year**: yearly subscription.
- **Month**: monthly subscription (default).

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region in which the DTS instance resides. For more information, see [List of supported regions](~~141033~~).
